retrieval.statement: This run is not just seed-level variation: it shows a concentrated degradation in task execution and technical reliability. Compared with the reference fine-tunes, it is more likely to leave templates unfilled or echo the prompt, return placeholder/stub code instead of a working implementation, hard-code examples, or omit required integration details. On math, science, engineering, and programming prompts it often gives overconfident but internally inconsistent reasoning, unsupported assumptions, wrong formulas, or ignores robustness/edge-case constraints. It also sometimes invents an unsupported continuation or explanatory claim, and can degrade into repetitive low-quality output. A smaller secondary tendency is to preserve harsher/destructive framing in metaphorical prompts rather than softening it as the references do.
